result.brief: EnvDreamer 利用大语言与视觉语言模型生成 UE5 交互式具身训练环境，并发布 2 万场景数据集，服务于机器人策略训练与 real-to-sim 重建。
result.reason: Generates interactive UE5 environments for embodied AI and robot training, with policies and real-to-sim reconstruction; environment/physical world modeling for embodied simulation fits the secondary application direction.
